title: Solomon's Wisdom and Wealth
description: Solomon ruled over all the kingdoms from the Euphrates to the land of the Philistines and to the border of Egypt, and these peoples brought him tribute. His daily provisions were enormous, and he had peace on every side while Judah and Israel lived in safety, each man under his own vine and fig tree. God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding beyond measure, so that he became wiser than all the people of the East and all the wise men of Egypt. He spoke three thousand proverbs and composed a thousand and five songs. He spoke about trees, from the cedar in Lebanon to the hyssop on the wall; he also spoke about animals, birds, creeping things, and fish. People came from all nations to hear his wisdom.
